description: Employee reviews scraped from Glassdoor with ratings, pros and cons, reviewer context, language data, employer responses, company context, company logo, and canonical review URLs. With onlyNew, reviews also carry isNew, firstSeenAt, lastSeenAt, changed, and lastChangedAt monitoring fields. The run status and RUN_SUMMARY key-value record expose the saved/available/siteTotal/stopReason completeness contract, plus monitorId/newReviews/unchangedReviews when monitoring is on. Set includeCompanySummary to add companySummary records to the same dataset.

reviews.description: Dataset containing one record per Glassdoor employee review.
reviews.title: Company Reviews
